question: Which of the following is the energy currency for most cellular processes?
solution:
The correct answer is **__ATP__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **ATP(Adenosine Triphosphate):**

 
 
• It is an **organic compound** composed of **phosphate groups, adenine, and sugar ribose**.
 
• These molecules **provide energy** for various **biochemical processes** in the body.
 
• **That is why it is called Energy Currency of the Cell. Hence, Option 3 is correct.**
 
• The ATP molecule was** discovered in the year 1929** by German chemist** Karl Lohmann**.
 
• These ATP molecules are synthesized by **Mitochondria**, therefore it is **called the powerhouse of the cell**.
 
• **In the year 1948**, Scottish biochemist** Alexander Todd** was the first person to **synthesize the ATP molecule**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ADP(Adenosine diphosphate)**:

 
 
• **It is an important organic compound in metabolism and is essential to the flow of energy in living cells.**
 
• It is essential in **photosynthesis and glycolysis.**
 
• It is the end-product when adenosine triphosphate **ATP loses one of its phosphate groups.**
 
• The energy released in the process is used to power up many **vital cellular processes.**
 
• **ADP reconverts to ATP by the addition of a phosphate group to ADP. **
